recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit as-is. No follow-up source work is recommended for FHIR-3261 unless Patient Care wants a broader editorial rewrite of the Questionnaire-versus-resources guidance.
issue_request: FHIR-3261 was a Published/Persuasive Patient Care change request for core Questionnaire. It objected that example text saying a Questionnaire SHALL be stored and communicated as a whole used conformance language where only illustrative guidance was intended.
initial_application: No explicit FHIR-3261-tagged source commit was found. Git history shows the questioned sentence was introduced in 6bf66c167ce30cc7fe9398849a898c25880cdb92 and then changed in 54ddc30bbb4ff904ff5e5c0f7cce9088b15b19c6, which replaced the SHALL wording with 'capturing the data in a Questionnaire would be most appropriate' one day after the issue was created.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists questionnaire as an active current-build resource, and source/questionnaire/questionnaire-notes.xml still contains the qversusr section referenced by the issue. Targeted Jira, Zulip, and Confluence searches found no later related decision or community record that changes the Jira/source/history conclusion.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The current qversusr narrative presents the physician-agreed form scenario as an example of when Questionnaire capture may be appropriate and does not contain the old conformance SHALL.
